title: From Tiny Acorns (miniquest)
start: Speak to Darren Lightfinger in his cellar accessed through a trapdoor north of Lumbridge furnace.

rewards.t: Ability to steal a craftsman's monocle
Ability to purchase crafting equipment from Urist Loric
Access to the pickpocketing volunteers, advanced pickpocketing trainer and coshing volunteers in the Thieves' Guild
Access to the practice chest area in the Thieves' Guild

steps.t: Talk to Darren Lightfinger in the Thieves' Guild. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to the market guard in Varrock Square. [Chat: 2 Who's the dwarf over there? › 1 Do you know what he's working on?]
Pickpocket Urist Loric until successful. He is the dwarf just north east of the Varrock General Store.
Left click to put-down Urist's talisman.
To steal from the crafting stall, follow these steps quickly:

sub.t: Run to the guard and right-click to distract him.

steps.t: Talk to Urist Loric for the banker's note.
Go back to the Thieves' Guild
Use the banker's note on Darren with the toy dragon in the backpack.
